hints.content:
The function is decreasing, so the left Riemann sum will overestimate the actual area:

![The graph of function g has the shaded area divided into 5 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/77ebac8ca0143d7c6b7149e79aeea7b9373de5f5)

And the right Riemann sum will underestimate:

![The graph of function g has the shaded area divided into 5 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/b1dd42bcf71c7a00494a157546168e11379ea646)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Right Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Left Riemann sum
